title: OBSIDIA
desc: OBSIDIA is a remote and enigmatic place, suspended between the present and the unknown, somewhere between tranquility and unease, where reality seems to dissolve. It may feel like an escape from everything, yet there is always a lingering sense that something more awaits, something yet to be discovered.

title: The Phoenix Art Collective
desc: The Phoenix Art Collective is a space in which artists can display their artwork. It aims to provide a community feel, somewhere to sit and chat, develop ideas with each other, and enjoy the experience. They welcome old friends, new artists, and art lovers alike. A new name, a new chapter, and a renewed passion for Second Life art.

title: UNITY Art Gallery
desc: UNITY Art Gallery is a vibrant space where art goes beyond the canvas and becomes an experience. Here, artists, musicians, writers, and creators come together to share their vision and build an atmosphere where every visitor becomes part of the moment.

title: Malinas Galerie
desc: You are invited to a compelling exhibition of black-and-white photography by the artist Malina Emerald. Enter a world stripped of color, where the profound depth and drama of the subject matter are revealed through the masterful use of monochrome. Malina’s work is a powerful exploration of light and shadow, relying purely on the interplay between black, white, and subtle grey tones.

title: Tiger Lily Art Gallery
desc: A gallery exploring the dark side of human nature through the power of expressive painting and the ascetic aesthetics of neo-primitivism.

title: KOO store
desc: KOO Store at Motherland carries random things by Eupalinos Ugajin, including PBR materials, 3D sculptures, some cats, and a green dinosaur.

title: Wizardly Art Gallery
desc: Wizardly Art Gallery is a place where the soul rests and the mind finds harmony. Need some exclusives for your home decor - come and take a unique masterpiece to your home. Come, explore, relax, and enjoy.

title: The Jennifer Steele Gallery & Cafe
desc: The Jennifer Steele Gallery & Cafe has original Art by real-life Canadian artist Jennifer Steele including paintings, photography, drawings, sculpture, abstract, realism, expressionism, impressionism, and the Artist's Cafe!

title: The Lost Unicorn Gallery
desc: Art gallery specializing in fantasy artwork, most created here in SL by some of the best artists in world!  They have monthly exhibits and events to enjoy!

title: Leyenda Designs
desc: Leyenda Designs is a decor store and art gallery offering a curated collection of statues, fountains, and backdrops, catering to a variety of aesthetic preferences. Visitors can explore an array of art pieces, each designed to enhance virtual environments. Custom requests are welcomed, allowing for personalized creations that meet specific needs and visions.

title: The Looking Glass at Horizon Dream
desc: The Looking Glass is the joint creation of Marcus Inkpen and Sharni Azalee. Beautiful art and designs populate this photogenic island, which aims to host and support the arts in Second Life through live music, particle shows, and poetry readings.

title: Better Together Forever Gallery
desc: Come enjoy the gallery and its grounds, which change with every passing season. Here, for your enjoyment, you will find digital art, a zen water garden, poetry readings, a film study featuring the top movies of the last 100 years, an ongoing seminar series featuring Latin American music genres and key composers, and live music from time to time. This is a place to relax and enjoy the arts in multiple forms. You are invited to come and join in the activities here.

title: Morris Code Studios
desc: Morris Code studios features the artwork of Poppy Morris. This little city and the surrounding area give a nod to solarpunk and lunarpunk aesthetics, while existing in an imaginary landscape.

title: Palace of Fine Art
desc: Welcome to the Palace of Fine Art, on the canals in the heart of beautiful Bay City. The Palace is home to the Evergarden Gallery and All the Best café where you can enjoy an afternoon in the luxurious art museum, explore the gardens, shop, and relax with friends. Take the Bay City Ferry, ride the bus, or take the teleport. Only the finest make it to the Palace!

title: Elven Falls
desc: Elven Falls is a UK and USA based art orientated community with galleries, stores, and unique housing.

title: The Vordun Museum and Gallery
desc: The Vordun Museum and Gallery is an art and history experience like no other in Second Life! Browse the many galleries and exhibits, then enjoy a coffee in the Common Grounds cafe.

title: Fondazione Isabella e Walter Madoi
desc: Explore a space devoted to Italian artist and sculptor Walter Madoi. Established by his Foundation, this official space features highlights from his massive collection of oil paintings, sculptures and fresco projects.

title: ArtSpace UTSA
desc: ArtSpace UTSA is a gallery located on the virtual campus of the University of Texas at San Antonio. New exhibits will open roughly every other month.

title: Kohakudo Gallery
desc: Kohakudo Gallery is a quiet space filled with art. Each painting has its own colors, atmosphere, and story. Visitors can take their time, wander through the gallery, and find a piece that speaks to them. Come in, take a closer look, and find your favorite piece. Thank you for supporting Kohakudo Art Gallery.

title: 7th Gallery
desc: Welcome to 7th Gallery, a warm and creative corner of Second Life where expressions and abstractions come alive. Here, every piece invites you to pause, feel, and wander through color, movement, and emotion. Guests are always welcome to explore the collection, enjoy the atmosphere, and experience the unique artistic voice that shapes this vibrant space.

title: Irelund Museum of American Art
desc: The Irelund Museum of American Art showcases nearly 100 reproductions of American artworks spanning from the late 1700s to the present. Explore galleries covering major artistic movements, browse free exhibition catalogs, and visit rotating special exhibitions in a museum inspired by real-world art history.

title: The Mavin Tinker Gallery Museum
desc: An art gallery museum in Bay City, hosting 6 floors of work from many SL artists spanning the years.

title: The Artist's Loft
desc: You step out of the lift door in a former warehouse building and see before you a corridor leading to an artist's workplace and studio. With views over York, she works creating the artwork you find hung on the walls. Enjoy some calm in The Artist's Loft. These are the RL drawings and paintings of Sammie. No AI was used in their creation. Enjoy your visit.

title: Monnada Art Gallery
desc: Monnada Art Gallery is currently featuring the exhibit Tales of Hallucinations by Night Lefevre. Tales of Hallucinations is a thought-provoking art show that reimagines classic tales through the lens of artificial intelligence. In this exhibition, human prompts are used as catalysts for AI-generated artworks and poems, breathing life into timeless stories and myths.

title: Algorithmic Dreams Art
desc: Located along Route 8A in The Bend, Algorithmic Dreams by Alan showcases vibrant wall art in various styles from modern digital design to soft watercolors. Visitors can explore a diverse collection of romantic portraits, serene landscapes, and expressive animal art. Each piece combines digital artistry with emotional warmth, perfect for both homes and businesses.

title: Souland Gallery
desc: A realm where art meets soul, Souland Gallery is dedicated to showcasing breathtaking creations from talented artists across Second Life. This gallery is a haven for those who cherish the beauty of artistic expression and the connections it inspires.

title: Salient Contemporary Art Gallery
desc: Salient Contemporary Art Gallery promotes a vibrant and inclusive arts and culture experience in SL and beyond. This gallery is a curated, rotational gallery exhibition space for emerging artists focused on non-second life-related work.

title: Michiel Bechir Gallery
desc: The Michiel Bechir Gallery is a place for both Second Life photographers and people who are interested in art. There are monthly events with a DJ or a live artist.

title: Cloud Galleries
desc: Cloud Galleries is a sky art district above Corsica in Corsica South Coasters, curated by Owl Dragonash. Rotating exhibitions by resident and guest artists unfold across connected sky spaces, with seasonal installations woven throughout the corridor. Visitors can walk directly to NovaOwl’s Sky Gallery and Late Night Lounge, as well as Ceakay Ballyhoo’s installation area and evolving seasons.

title: Summer'S ArtisanS
desc: Imaginative art gallery, handbuilt with love. Future expositions will be held, till that time it's open for the public. It is mysterious, relaxing, and Flickr friendly.

title: Shui Mo Gallery
desc: Explore the artwork of Resident FionaFei at the Shiu Mo Gallery. Shui Mo, meaning "ink" in Chinese, is a series of installations created in the style of Chinese ink brush painting, depicting a common theme or landscape seen in many traditional Chinese paintings.

title: Recalcitrante Gallery
desc: Take a ride with I am Free’s Ducati motorbike in her personal gallery, Recalcitrante Gallery, and take a look at her photos and installations. There is always a DJ booth ready to welcome you if you want to organize an evening and new exhibitions every few months. The music is curated by The Globalconnection which is available on the parcels audio stream.

title: NovaOwl
desc: NovaOwl is an international community and destination on the mainland continent of Corsica located on Novatron. It is a hangout and meeting place with regularly scheduled events. There is a cafe, fishing contests, boat rezzing areas, and an Art Gallery on a waterfront location.

title: ArtCare Gallery
desc: ArtCare Gallery is a very large art venue, including 5 levels The Gallery welcomes you with a public garden that serves as a gateway into a wonderful collection of SL art. It is highly recommended to use the shared environment!

title: Vivienne Varela Art Gallery
desc: Vivienne's Art Gallery features five floors of original art by Vivienne, which showcase an eclectic mix of Vivienne's real-world and Second Life art. Her signature style of big canvases, bold, bright colours and strong design can be seen in her eclectic subjects and styles. Visitors can enjoy couples dining, coffee and dancing whilst strolling through the very striking art on display.

title: COLORFUL Gallery
desc: Colorful Gallery is the starting point of a private collection open to the public, divided into three galleries containing works by both established and unknown artists with sculptures and photos, real or virtual, to visit and discover part of the vast world of art in Second Life.

title: Coastal Galleries
desc: Coastal Galleries is a vibrant collaboration of creativity! Across the coastal village, art unfolds in many forms: bold installations, intimate displays, experimental pieces, and personal expressions from creators who treat Olympus as both sanctuary and stage. Every visit feels like stepping into a new story.

title: Digital Arts Gallery
desc: The Digital Arts Gallery hosts artists and exhibitions year-round. They are a group of artists who enjoy sharing art and ideas about art and work with up-and-coming and established artists. The work they exhibit varies from photography to sculpture, to interactive, and also work in between.

title: Subcutan Art Gallery
desc: The Subcutan Main Gallery and central teleporting point to all Subcutan Galleries and the beautiful Japanese garden for walking, recharging, or simply relaxing.

title: The Annex of Nitroglobus
desc: The Annex is an extension to the main hall of the Nitroglobus Roof Gallery. It is a platform for emerging artists to showcase their work.

title: The Studio Collection
desc: The Studio Collection features a curated gallery of small installations, models, and works in progress on the ground level. A collection of artwork from noted artists is displayed upstairs. Visitors can also explore “All the Songs We Never Sang,” a thoughtful installation located on a platform above.

title: NUNA
desc: NUNA is an arts ecosystem, a region of themed galleries with experimental works by living artists, real world and virtual, and a collection of culturally significant pieces. NUNA has an education focus. Artworks on display are captioned and contextualised; the goal is to display art in context so that it can be better understood.

title: Peter Vos Museum
desc: Explore the artwork and creations of Dutch artist Peter Vos in this loving exhibit curated by his son Sander.

title: Moya Museum
desc: The Moya Museum of Contemporary Art presents a retrospective of the works of French artist Patrick Moya from 1974 to the present day. It is one of the main buildings in the Moya Islands.

title: Nitroglobus Roof Gallery
desc: Nitroglobus Gallery is a Second Life art gallery that shows impressive exhibitions and installations of both emerging and well-known artists and is owned and curated by Dido Haas.

title: Maps of Second Life
desc: Home of the exhibit "Maps of Second Life" in the New Kadath Lighthouse Art Gallery, curated by Professor Juliana Lethdetter-DeCuir. It is an exploration of the Main Grid’s history, geography, and culture as depicted via maps and cartography.

title: Virtual Hotel Chelsea
desc: Virtual Hotel Chelsea was created in 2009 and is a faithful replica of the famed New York Bohemian hangout that was home to many famous and infamous guests. Come and attend the weekly live music events (accomplished musicians play their own instruments) or take a stroll around the surrounding streets which house over 40 amazing art galleries, or maybe join a tour of the hotel itself to discover its secrets and history.

title: The Inbetween
desc: The Inbetween is a coffee, art, and community space in the heart of the CSC Mainland Community. Part gallery, part café, part gathering place, it features changing art, coffee, conversation, and events. Stay a while or wander on, with direct access to the Monte Corse hiking trail and Circuit la Corse, one of the continent’s main roads.

title: GALLERIES
desc: Welcome to GALLERIES, a satellite gallery dedicated to the work of Sharon Emerald and connected to the creative community of Coastal Galleries. Inspired by the spirit of collaboration, they proudly support a vibrant village where diverse artists share their unique collections and creative visions.

title: Cantelou Art Gallery
desc: A vast art gallery built in a brutalist style. A monumental structure made of heavy, raw concrete, striking geometric shapes, and massive open spaces that make visitors feel small yet focused on the art. Miles Cantelou’s artwork bridges physical and digital spaces by blending abstract expressionism and immersive SL virtual creations.

title: The Azuralis Museum and Archives
desc: Welcome to The Azuralis Museum and Archives. More than just an ever-evolving museum, it is a destination for hunts, music, original works of art, and a mystery that will unfold over the next several years. Be part of the Azuralis and watch the story unfold through hunts and quests, some obvious, some hidden and waiting to be discovered. Great music weekly at The Azuralis Stage.

title: Sassy Art Gallery
desc: Sassy Art Gallery is a Mediterranean-inspired outdoor gallery where local artists showcase their work in a scenic setting of marble walkways, arches, waterfalls, and ocean views. Connected to a café, it offers a relaxing place to enjoy art, gather with friends, and find inspiration.

title: Notable Art Gallery
desc: A glass conservatory for fine art and poetry. Explore the garden and rotating exhibits within a Highlands setting. Share your voice and story. Drawing, watercolors, oil paintings, acrylic paintings, charcoal, photography (both real life and Second Life), and poetry. Come sit, relax, and enjoy.

title: Gallery of Nim's Art
desc: Nim’s Art Gallery features fine art, photos, and relief-style images, with select pieces available for purchase. Visitors can also request custom artwork. The space includes profile-style imagery and showcases work in both English and German.

title: Time Lost Art
desc: Time Lost Art is an art gallery in Bay City dedicated to the appreciation of the arts.

title: SLRandom ArtCrew
desc: The SLRandom ArtCrew presents an experiential region that explores art, the Awareness Gallery, all set within an idyllic rural shire fantasy landscape.

title: The Termites
desc: A creative hub with nine themed stages combining light shows, music, dance, and art. The Termites also hosts galleries, artist platforms, and cultural events. It's a vibrant destination where imagination comes alive.

title: Deep End Records
desc: Deep End Records is a small nostalgic experience in the form of an audio gallery. Do you ever miss the times when you could go to the mall and listen to music? Now you can relive this feeling while also exploring the creative talent of Second Life Residents.

title: The Tudors Art Gallery
desc: Come and have a look at the photography art captured by Alex Tudor, with imagery formed by his fantasy as well as inspired by photogenic Second Life destinations. Every view tells its own tale as well as the angle used, with that moment captured on the canvas forever.

title: Kultivate Arts
desc: Kultivate Arts features four art galleries that showcase the art of both new and established artists in the virtual world of Second Life. The arts center also has two venues and an attached scenic region for photographers and artists to explore. For more info: www.kultivatemagazine.com

title: Kondor Art Center
desc: The Kondor Art Center is a place for art, photography, installations, music, dance, theatre, and other cultural events in Second Life. Composed of the Kondor Art Gallery (1 and 2), the Kondor Art Garden, the Kondor Art Square, the Kondor Art Club, the Museum, and other small art galleries, the Kondor Art Center has one cultural event each week.

title: Glimpses of the Sanctuary
desc: Glimpses of the Sanctuary is an immersive experience as seen through the eyes of Photographer Tallis Blackwood. Please turn up sounds, lower music, and use the shared environment. Allow yourself to be transported to the secret home of the Lotus! Enjoy!

title: Hypnagogia Gallery
desc: Hypnagogia is the eclectic photography of Hepburn. Her work varies from Whimsical to somewhat Macabre. She is also an accomplished landscape and portrait artist. Some works are available to purchase.

title: Zoe Gallery
desc: The Zoe Gallery showcases a collection of Friedl Aigner's artworks, featuring Austrian and South French landscape drawings and paintings. These pieces, primarily from the 1980s and 1990s, reflect Aigner's real-life inspirations and artistic endeavors, offering visitors a diverse visual experience.

title: The Carbone Studio
desc: The Carbone Studio presents the artworks of Milena Carbone which includes her writings, her pictorial works, and choreographies. It is also a pleasant relaxing place, with its dance room that broadcasts music videos on a giant screen 24 hours a day.

title: Art Galerie HaXue
desc: HaXue is an international art gallery and haven spanning six floors, all crafted with Second Life's integrated tools. It's a place for dreams, friendship, and artistic exchange, complete with gardens, events, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Your creative spirit is always welcome here.

title: Centauria Community Gallery
desc: An art gallery focused on fantasy and story-telling with regular exhibits and events. It is a part of the Centauria Community Regions.

title: HeArt & Soul Gallery
desc: The HeArt & Soul Gallery welcomes you to explore art that touches your heart, your soul, and your mind. The exhibiting artists change bi-monthly, with different themes, different styles, and different perspectives.

title: BOSL Innovation Pavillion
desc: BOSL Innovation Pavillion is home to the Best of Second Life Magazine brand which promotes all things fashion-related. Find some of the best designers, models, magazines, pageants, art shows, and more! You can also visit the winery, cafe, gardens, and the Art Gallery which showcases some of the best artists in Second Life.

title: Photo Cafe
desc: Photo Cafe' is a meeting place for all SL Photographers (at any level) to gather and share experiences, hints, tips, and tricks, landmarks or contests (inworld or on socials), and whatever else comes to mind! They hold moderated discussions, events, and exclusive or retrospective exhibits. Learn more at www.photocafe.news

title: Andante Gallery
desc: Andante Gallery on the Surplus Motors region proudly presents a variety of artists rotating on a monthly basis.

title: The Hannington Arts Foundation
desc: The Hannington Arts Foundation at Xeltentat Enterprises features Second Life artists at their Memory Gongs collaborative galleries. It's three galleries built together, each with their distinctive style, to show Second Life pictures, First Life pictures, and Erotic pictures. It's a collaborative effort that features photographs from Sweet Susanowa, Violaine, and Therese Carfagno. The pictures are for sale at different prices. The galleries are built to be walker-friendly, and in between, there are places to sit down and relax.

title: Bear Castle
desc: Come see the creativity of 800+ Linden Bears, Mole Bears, and Boopies, collected by multiple Residents over the years. Also, pick up a free box of bears for your own collection!

title: Ravens Eye Gallery
desc: Ravens Eye Gallery showcases original SL Photography by Raven Arcana with impressions of virtual landscapes.

title: Yobe Gallery - Yoko Ayukawa Exhibition
desc: Japanese RL artist Yoko Ayukawa presents an art exhibition at Yobe Gallery. You will find yourself surrounded by vibrant colors and whimsical artworks that will bring a feeling of joy and youthfulness to your heart. While the gallery itself is small and cozy, the space is still open and welcoming. More information about the artist yobe.com

title: Toy's Art Gallery
desc:
Toy's Art Gallery is a five-floor gallery of Toysoldier Thor's eclectic
styles of digital art. Tour through his gallery of over 80 works encompassing real and Second Life photography and 3d mesh sculptures. Visitors are encouraged to touch each piece, and will be presented with a notecard of the artist's comments about each one. All art is available for sale.

title: The Retreat
desc: The Retreat is a beautiful hang-out with a lush garden, art gallery and the Basement Club. Enjoy, take pictures and bring friends to this wonderful place!

title: The Free Museum
desc: The Free Museum contains over 70 works by some of the best artists in Second Life, and visitors are invited to take a free copy of every work exhibited. There is nothing for sale or any solicitations. And it is newcomer friendly: there are simple instructions on how to take a work home and how to resize it to fit your home. It is a great introduction to the art world of Second Life.

title: Selen's Gallery
desc: Selen’s gallery, open since 2020, has original art by the French digital artist on 2 levels, including a machinima room. The gallery has also extensions exhibiting a new round of other 2D and 3D artists every 3 months.

title: Second Life Endowment For The Arts
desc: Use the Second Life Endowment For The Arts (SLEA) experience to visit 9 regions of diverse creativity representing the many levels of virtual art in SL, including 2 & 3D, Theater, Literature, Visual, Machinima, Art Education, and Media Art. Cost-free grants are awarded! Learn more at sleagrants.com

title: Renaissance Gallery
desc: As the name suggests, this gallery showcases artwork from the late Middle Ages, when artists like Leonardo and Botticelli were at their peak. Small, but a must-see for fans of this period.

title: Peace is a Choice Gallery
desc: For over 18+yrs this Non-Profit Foundation has been presenting some of the finest art, sculptures, mesh, and non-mesh installations within Second Life!

title: MEROE Museum
desc: MEROE Museum is the Home of Black and Aboriginal cultures in Second Life. The Museum's purpose is to provide a safe space for the repository of black culture from across the diaspora, and a place for dialog in an effort to resolve many of the conflicts that plague our communities.

title: Isme Fine Arts
desc: Isme Fine Arts Galleries house the sensual real-life art of Lisisme Dubrovna and 7 more galleries featuring many others. Lisisme has shown in galleries all over SL and is one of the few in SL to show RL artwork that uses traditional media of sculpture and etching, lithograph, and pen and ink. 3D scans of her sculptures are mesh in SL.

title: CK's Corner
desc: CK's Corner is a beautifully decorated part of mainland where you can find Ceakay Ballyhoo's art gallery, her collection of art from SL artists, The Roofgarden Galleries, a butterfly conservatory, and a camp. CK's Corner is part of Corsica South Coasters and is nearby the Corsica Tourist Center.

title: Center Ground Gallery of Art
desc: The Center Ground Gallery of Art is an ongoing collection of the original Art of JudiLynn, curated by JudiLynn India and hosted on the Center Ground Region by Luchenpur Darwin. The gallery has been in operation since 2012 and has hosted many other real-world artists as well. It's also a great spot for relaxing with a board game, enjoying the stream, and dancing.

title: Cape Able Art Gallery
desc: The Cape Able Art Gallery is a beautiful, eclectic gallery hosting art exhibits by deaf and/or disabled artists. Exhibits change quarterly.  Artists can be contacted privately for the sale of their works. Cape Able is a nonprofit, Virtual Ability Inc. owned region. The latest exhibit is Latté Foam Etchings by DocNeuro Cyants. This exhibit will be open throughout the month of May.
